BackstoryDef.title: long hall child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up under lamps that had burned for a thousand years. The sky was something in old engravings, and the idea of weather seemed like an obvious design flaw.

BackstoryDef.title: oil runner
BackstoryDef.description: Children small enough to fit inside the great engines did useful work inside them. [PAWN_nameDef] knows the sound a bad bearing makes and still has the scars to show how [PAWN_pronoun] learned.

BackstoryDef.title: student of proofs
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was expected to prove every statement at the family table, including requests to pass the salt. It made for an unusual education and very quiet dinners.

BackstoryDef.title: hall warden
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stood at the lower gates, holding them against things that came up from the deep dark. Falmer were the usual problem. They were not the worst of them.

BackstoryDef.title: gallery marksman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] shot from narrow galleries built for the purpose, with a crossbow [PAWN_pronoun] had taken apart and improved twice. [PAWN_pronoun] does not understand why nobody else bothers doing that.

BackstoryDef.title: centurion mechanic
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the clan's last few centurions walking with salvaged parts and dark language. Most of them have outlived several of their mechanics already.

BackstoryDef.title: tonal theorist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent eighty years working on a single harmonic proof, finished it and found a mistake in the third line. [PAWN_pronoun] is now somewhat more relaxed about the whole subject.

BackstoryDef.title: bronze smith
BackstoryDef.description: Dwemer metal keeps its shine because of how it is worked, and [PAWN_nameDef] has never told anyone outside the clan how that is done. People have asked, some of them unpleasantly.

BackstoryDef.title: deep surveyor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] mapped new tunnels and cataloged old ones, marking collapses and sealing the galleries that should stay sealed. There are a few [PAWN_pronoun] will not discuss.

BackstoryDef.title: bronze quarter child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up where the pipes ran hottest, learning arithmetic from pressure gauges. The first word [PAWN_pronoun] ever spelled was on a warning plate.

BackstoryDef.title: disputation prodigy
BackstoryDef.description: At nine, [PAWN_nameDef] argued a Clan Rkund elder to a standstill on a point of tonal law. The elder never forgave it, and that was considered high praise.

BackstoryDef.title: lower gallery child
BackstoryDef.description: Falmer thralls did the worst of the digging, and [PAWN_nameDef] grew up keeping tallies on them. Nobody in the family ever thought it needed justifying.

BackstoryDef.title: spider tinkerer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rebuilt a broken spider worker at eleven and made it follow [PAWN_objective] around the hall, which a few relatives found less charming than others.

BackstoryDef.title: tuner's apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: The great resonators had to be kept in pitch, and small children have good ears. [PAWN_nameDef] spent years in the tuning shafts, and still winces at most music.

BackstoryDef.title: Clan Kragen child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s people came west to Skyrim following the Rourken and made their home at Arkngthamz, where the elders never stopped complaining about the cold.

BackstoryDef.title: disputant of the halls
BackstoryDef.description: Dwemer clans settled their feuds with proofs far more often than swords. [PAWN_nameDef] argued cases that ran for decades and won most of those [PAWN_pronoun] lived to see finished.

BackstoryDef.title: steam fitter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the boilers under a whole quarter from killing anyone. The job is entirely invisible until the day it is not.

BackstoryDef.title: aetherium smelter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked the Aetherium Forge at Arkngthamz, where four clans fought to control a metal that nobody had finished understanding.

BackstoryDef.title: lamp warden
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] looked after thousands of lamps fed from deep in the rock. Most of them will outlast the people who lit them, which is the point.

BackstoryDef.title: cavern farmer
BackstoryDef.description: Even engineers eat. [PAWN_nameDef] managed the mushroom galleries with irrigation tables that would make a surface farmer weep.

BackstoryDef.title: thrall overseer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed Falmer labor in the deep works, and thought of it as a problem of logistics. The Snow Elves have a different word for it.

BackstoryDef.title: Rourken hammerman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in the warhost of a clan that would throw a hammer across a continent rather than sign a bad treaty.

BackstoryDef.title: First Council veteran
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fought on the fields of Resdayn alongside Chimer and Dwemer alike, against the Nords, and later against those same Chimer. [PAWN_pronoun] keeps the maps.

BackstoryDef.title: ballista crewman
BackstoryDef.description: The great bolt throwers on the upper gates needed careful sums and steady nerves. [PAWN_nameDef] had both, and rather enjoyed showing off the first.

BackstoryDef.title: gate sentinel
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] walked beside the centurions on the gate. They never complained about the hours, and neither did [PAWN_pronoun].

BackstoryDef.title: animunculi binder
BackstoryDef.description: A working machine needs a spark, and [PAWN_nameDef] knew where to find them. Soul gems were a bookkeeping item, and [PAWN_pronoun] kept the books.

BackstoryDef.title: Mzulft astronomer
BackstoryDef.description: The Oculory at Mzulft focused light through crystal to study what lay behind the sky. [PAWN_nameDef] measured the gods up there and published the results.

BackstoryDef.title: Kagrenac's pupil
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] studied under the Chief Tonal Architect and wrote out his sums. Some of those pages have since been taken into the Heart's chamber, and [PAWN_pronoun] has wondered about them ever since.

BackstoryDef.title: vault reader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] catalogued the sealed vaults of Bthardamz, including one marked only with a warning in a hand [PAWN_pronoun] recognized as [PAWN_possessive] own.

BackstoryDef.title: ruin salvager
BackstoryDef.description: Generations after the great vanishing, [PAWN_nameDef] picks through halls that [PAWN_possessive] own ancestors designed. The family trade is now more like grave robbing.

BackstoryDef.title: keeper of the treaty
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s family still holds a copy of the treaty Chief Rourken refused, kept out in plain view for the sake of argument. Clan disputes have started over less.

BackstoryDef.title: Deathlands delver
BackstoryDef.description: The clan's oldest stories end at Volenfell. [PAWN_nameDef] went looking for the place itself, and came back with nothing but a sunburn and very firm views on Hammerfell.

BackstoryDef.title: Mzulft lens polisher
BackstoryDef.description: Children have small hands, and the great lenses at Mzulft have small flaws. [PAWN_nameDef] spent years with a cloth and a very stern instructor.

BackstoryDef.title: Nchuand-Zel dockling
BackstoryDef.description: Water from the deep lake at Nchuand-Zel ran through more pipes than a child could count. [PAWN_nameDef] tried counting them anyway and was made to start again.

BackstoryDef.title: Arkngthamz echo tester
BackstoryDef.description: Halls at Arkngthamz were built to be heard as well as seen. [PAWN_nameDef] walked them singing a single note while the elders took measurements.

BackstoryDef.title: Alftand kitchen child
BackstoryDef.description: Far under the snow at Alftand, meals came up from the fungus halls on schedule. [PAWN_nameDef] rode the lifts with the trays and learned every floor.

BackstoryDef.title: Raldbthar gear counter
BackstoryDef.description: At Raldbthar, a child's first paid job was counting teeth on gears nobody else had time to check. [PAWN_nameDef] once found an error, and got a small medal for it.

BackstoryDef.title: Blackreach lamp child
BackstoryDef.description: Blackreach had its own sky of glowing fungus, and [PAWN_nameDef] thought that was the normal sort. The first real sunlight, years later, was a disappointment.

BackstoryDef.title: Bthar-zel apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Bthar-zel's clan was proud of its smiths. [PAWN_nameDef] started young, carrying coal and being told that nothing made in another hold was worth a second look.

BackstoryDef.title: Vvardenfell tunnel child
BackstoryDef.description: Before Red Mountain's last war, Dwemer holds lay under much of the island. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up with the warm stone and never quite trusted any other kind.

BackstoryDef.title: Volenfell sand-sweeper
BackstoryDef.description: Hammerfell's sand gets into everything, including a sealed Dwemer hold. [PAWN_nameDef] cleaned it from the gears every morning, and it was back again the next.

BackstoryDef.title: Bamz-Amschend pipefitter
BackstoryDef.description: Bamz-Amschend sat under what would one day be Mournhold, full of steam and clever doors. [PAWN_nameDef] crawled through the pipes checking joints.

BackstoryDef.title: first proof
BackstoryDef.description: By age seven, every Dwemer child had to prove something true to the satisfaction of a stranger. [PAWN_nameDef] proved that the stranger was wrong, which was accepted.

BackstoryDef.title: clan archive runner
BackstoryDef.description: Disputes in the clan halls often came down to what an ancestor had actually written. [PAWN_nameDef] ran to fetch the tablet, and got to listen to the shouting.

BackstoryDef.title: gear-tooth filer
BackstoryDef.description: Metal shavings went in the hair, the food and the eyes. Filing gear teeth by hand was unglamorous, but [PAWN_nameDef] became very good at getting them true.

BackstoryDef.title: sphere's shadow
BackstoryDef.description: Sentry spheres patrolled the hall and did not much care about children, so long as they didn't touch. [PAWN_nameDef] touched one and has a small scar for it.

BackstoryDef.title: steam-valve child
BackstoryDef.description: An unattended valve can kill a hall. [PAWN_nameDef] was trusted to read one pressure gauge at age six and took that trust extremely seriously.

BackstoryDef.title: fungus farm child
BackstoryDef.description: Pale caps fed the holds, and they needed turning and damp. [PAWN_nameDef] worked the beds with a small rake and got told that farming was a branch of chemistry.

BackstoryDef.title: ore cart rider
BackstoryDef.description: The ore carts ran down a long incline toward the smelters. [PAWN_nameDef] was forbidden to ride them, and did so for years with only one broken arm.

BackstoryDef.title: tonal choir child
BackstoryDef.description: Tuning a resonator needs someone who can hold pitch without wavering. [PAWN_nameDef] sang one note for a very long time so that older Dwemer could break things with it.

BackstoryDef.title: Clan Rourken runt
BackstoryDef.description: Rourken children learned about hammers very early. As the smallest of the batch, [PAWN_nameDef] developed a great interest in hitting first.

BackstoryDef.title: Council hearing page
BackstoryDef.description: Councils could run for weeks over a word. [PAWN_nameDef] brought the water, saw the arguments up close and decided early that nothing had ever really been settled.

BackstoryDef.title: chimer-tongue learner
BackstoryDef.description: With the Chimer living just above, somebody had to learn their speech. [PAWN_nameDef] was taught it young and found the insults most useful.

BackstoryDef.title: thrall's friend
BackstoryDef.description: Falmer thralls were not meant to be spoken to. [PAWN_nameDef] did so anyway, with a shared meal at the deep shaft, and nobody ever told the overseer.

BackstoryDef.title: metal taster
BackstoryDef.description: An old smith could tell the blend of an alloy by licking it. [PAWN_nameDef] picked up that habit, along with a strange taste in the mouth that never left.

BackstoryDef.title: gallery sketcher
BackstoryDef.description: Every doorway in the hold had a pattern that meant something. [PAWN_nameDef] copied them all onto slate and had to be told, gently, that it wasn't a game.

BackstoryDef.title: lift operator's child
BackstoryDef.description: The lift to the surface took an hour and was a good place to overhear gossip. [PAWN_nameDef] sat with a parent on the top step and heard all of it.

BackstoryDef.title: automaton oiler
BackstoryDef.description: The oil was the same in the machines and on the bread, or so said the older children. [PAWN_nameDef] found out the truth the hard way and got over it within a week.

BackstoryDef.title: deep-shaft listener
BackstoryDef.description: Rock makes sounds before it moves. An old surveyor taught [PAWN_nameDef] to put an ear to the shaft wall, and the hall evacuated twice because of that child.

BackstoryDef.title: heir to a feud
BackstoryDef.description: Two clans had been arguing over one water rights tablet for six hundred years. [PAWN_nameDef] inherited the argument at birth, and a pair of bronze knuckles at ten.

BackstoryDef.title: hall orphan
BackstoryDef.description: An accident in the smelters left [PAWN_nameDef] with no family, and with a place at the clan's table regardless. Dwemer waste nothing, including children.

BackstoryDef.title: false doors expert
BackstoryDef.description: Half the doors at home were puzzles, and the rest were traps. [PAWN_nameDef] solved them for fun, until one particular door closed behind and stayed shut for two days.

BackstoryDef.title: clay model builder
BackstoryDef.description: Before any hall got cut from the rock, somebody made a small model of it first. [PAWN_nameDef] built them from clay and was allowed to suggest minor improvements.

BackstoryDef.title: fungus-ale thief
BackstoryDef.description: Fungus ale ferments slowly and vanishes quickly. [PAWN_nameDef] siphoned a cask for a whole winter and blamed it on evaporation, citing the correct figures.

BackstoryDef.title: aetherium dust sweeper
BackstoryDef.description: Some floors at the forge shone a bit too much. [PAWN_nameDef] swept them with a wet rag and a cough, and was told it was probably fine.

BackstoryDef.title: heat-gallery child
BackstoryDef.description: Warm galleries near the lava vents were the best place to sleep and the worst place to fall over. [PAWN_nameDef] learned to find the difference in the dark.

BackstoryDef.title: Mora scroll reader
BackstoryDef.description: An elder's Chimer-looted scroll described gods as if they were real. [PAWN_nameDef] laughed for an hour and then read all the footnotes in search of errors.

BackstoryDef.title: thread-gauge prodigy
BackstoryDef.description: By nine, [PAWN_nameDef] could cut a thread to within a hair's width, and could also explain to adults what was wrong with theirs. Few of them enjoyed it.

BackstoryDef.title: Rourken crossroads child
BackstoryDef.description: Traders from the Velothi Mountains came through the upper gates carrying news. [PAWN_nameDef] listened in, and the first map in that child's mind came from those stories.

BackstoryDef.title: boiler stoker's child
BackstoryDef.description: Heavy shovels build big arms, as [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents often remarked. A place by the boilers also meant never being cold, even at the bottom of Skyrim.

BackstoryDef.title: surface-seen child
BackstoryDef.description: At age ten, on a dare, [PAWN_nameDef] climbed all the way up to the entrance and saw snow. No amount of explanation could make that seem any less stupid afterward.

BackstoryDef.title: proof-board cleaner
BackstoryDef.description: The great slate at the end of the hall had to be cleaned once a theorem was over. [PAWN_nameDef] copied the good parts down first, and sold a few to students.

BackstoryDef.title: horn-bronze player
BackstoryDef.description: Great horns of bronze mark the change of shift in a large hold. [PAWN_nameDef] got to blow one at age eleven and could hear very little for the rest of the day.

BackstoryDef.title: animunculi commander
BackstoryDef.description: Centurions do what they're told precisely, which is where the danger is. [PAWN_nameDef] learned to give orders that couldn't be misread, and still does it at breakfast.

BackstoryDef.title: Volendrung bearer's guard
BackstoryDef.description: Rourken took Volendrung west with him, and [PAWN_nameDef]'s clan went along to keep an eye on it. Nothing else has ever seemed quite as heavy.

BackstoryDef.title: Aetherium War sapper
BackstoryDef.description: In the Aetherium Wars, four Dwemer cities went after the same forge and one another's walls. [PAWN_nameDef] dug under enemy halls and was buried twice by friends.

BackstoryDef.title: Red Mountain veteran
BackstoryDef.description: Chimer and Dwemer had been allies for generations before they fought at Red Mountain. [PAWN_nameDef] had been in that first battle, and had known some of the other side by name.

BackstoryDef.title: crossbow gallery captain
BackstoryDef.description: Crossbows in Dwemer holds are mounted, aimed and calibrated in advance. [PAWN_nameDef] had the range marked to every doorway and made sure each crew could recite them.

BackstoryDef.title: Falmer revolt suppressor
BackstoryDef.description: When thralls turned on the deep shafts, the clan sent someone to restore order. [PAWN_nameDef] did so, and no one asked how, as nobody really wanted to know.

BackstoryDef.title: guard of the Tonal Lens
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody without clearance went near the lens. [PAWN_nameDef] never knew what it did, only that a colleague once looked at it wrong and could not be found afterward.

BackstoryDef.title: hold-breaker
BackstoryDef.description: Enemy gates respond to the right note, a very large ram, or both. [PAWN_nameDef] led the sappers against a neighboring clan's gate over a dispute of honor and irrigation.

BackstoryDef.title: Nord-border raider
BackstoryDef.description: Nords came up the Reach valleys wanting Dwemer treasure. [PAWN_nameDef] went out to discuss it and took a few of them back down for further study.

BackstoryDef.title: Dwarven spear-drill sergeant
BackstoryDef.description: A formation of Dwemer spears moves as neatly as a gear train. [PAWN_nameDef] drilled them until they moved like one, and then started on the timing.

BackstoryDef.title: duelist of the Five Halls
BackstoryDef.description: Formal disputes between scholars could end in steel if logic failed. [PAWN_nameDef] accepted such commissions from people who were right but could not fight.

BackstoryDef.title: tunnel marshal
BackstoryDef.description: Keeping order at the bottom of a mine means knowing who is angry and how much rock is above them. [PAWN_nameDef] managed both, with limited patience.

BackstoryDef.title: ballista artificer
BackstoryDef.description: Tension is simple mathematics, and bolts are simple metal. [PAWN_nameDef] made each ballista personally and could put a bolt through a guar at a mile.

BackstoryDef.title: surface patrol captain
BackstoryDef.description: Few Dwemer would go up there willingly. [PAWN_nameDef] led the surface patrols for years, wearing dark glass and complaining without pause about the weather.

BackstoryDef.title: Dragon War veteran
BackstoryDef.description: Dragons rarely bother with deep halls, but they did burn the upper gates of more than one Dwemer city. [PAWN_nameDef] was stationed at one of those gates.

BackstoryDef.title: Sentinel of the Vault
BackstoryDef.description: Sealed vaults get a guard for a set term, and the term can be quite long. [PAWN_nameDef] served ninety years in one corridor, with a very clean record.

BackstoryDef.title: Tonal Architect
BackstoryDef.description: Stone will listen if you find its pitch, and metal is simply more stubborn about it. [PAWN_nameDef] built a door that opened only for one precise chord.

BackstoryDef.title: Kagrenac's lab assistant
BackstoryDef.description: Kagrenac wanted a great many measurements taken and did not explain why. [PAWN_nameDef] took them all and has since had time to think about what they were for.

BackstoryDef.title: Numidium foundry clerk
BackstoryDef.description: Parts for the Walking Brass came through in the thousands, each with a form attached. [PAWN_nameDef] filed those forms and had no idea of the shape they added up to.

BackstoryDef.title: heart-lore skeptic
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] argued that the Heart of Lorkhan was simply a very large energy source and that gods were bad data. This was a popular view and possibly the last one anybody held.

BackstoryDef.title: enchanter of bronze
BackstoryDef.description: Bronze accepts an enchantment poorly, unless it's cast and cooled at the right pitch. [PAWN_nameDef] tuned the forge by ear and got a remarkable hit rate.

BackstoryDef.title: soul-free centurion theorist
BackstoryDef.description: Animunculi run on soul gems, unless someone comes up with a better way. [PAWN_nameDef] spent a century trying that and left a shelf of very promising failures.

BackstoryDef.title: star-chart reckoner
BackstoryDef.description: Mzulft's oculory turned its beam on the skies, and [PAWN_nameDef] was in charge of the numbers. Those numbers suggested some rather rude things about the Aedra.

BackstoryDef.title: alchemy of oils
BackstoryDef.description: Dwarven oil keeps the gears turning, and is also a fine antiseptic. [PAWN_nameDef] discovered this by accident and recommended only the first use to others.

BackstoryDef.title: physician of the halls
BackstoryDef.description: Crush injuries, burns and hearing loss are the main ailments of Dwemer cities. [PAWN_nameDef] saw all three daily and treated them with brisk, unsentimental competence.

BackstoryDef.title: sonic healer
BackstoryDef.description: Bone knits a little faster at the proper frequency, or so went [PAWN_nameDef]'s claim. Patients reported some improvement and a lasting dislike of chimes.

BackstoryDef.title: disproof-writer
BackstoryDef.description: Every Dwemer religion is a mistake to be corrected in writing. [PAWN_nameDef] wrote fifty-one disproofs of the Aedra, and sent copies to the Chimer for comment.

BackstoryDef.title: lightning coil keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Storm-coils hold a charge so long as nothing's touching them. [PAWN_nameDef] walked between them in leather boots with very good posture.

BackstoryDef.title: memory-core keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Records of a clan can be stored in an arrangement of metal cylinders. [PAWN_nameDef] looked after them and quietly corrected a few that hadn't been flattering.

BackstoryDef.title: mathematical priest
BackstoryDef.description: Dwemer have no priests, except that someone must conduct the funeral and read the numbers aloud. [PAWN_nameDef] did this with total conviction and no deity.

BackstoryDef.title: resonance surveyor
BackstoryDef.description: Strike a rod into the rock, listen, and repeat for a hundred miles. [PAWN_nameDef] found a large aetherium seam in this way, and got no share of it.

BackstoryDef.title: conjuration denier
BackstoryDef.description: Daedra are simply a form of badly documented weather, in [PAWN_nameDef]'s published view. A summoned one disagreed strongly, and the paper got a second edition.

BackstoryDef.title: Dwarven glass maker
BackstoryDef.description: Lenses for the oculory came from this workshop and no other. [PAWN_nameDef] rejected nine out of ten and kept the rejects as drinking glasses.

BackstoryDef.title: mechanical clockmaker
BackstoryDef.description: Time runs differently without a sun. [PAWN_nameDef] made the clocks by which the whole hold woke, ate and argued.

BackstoryDef.title: metal-law advocate
BackstoryDef.description: Clans go to law over the ownership of ore before it has been mined. [PAWN_nameDef] represented them with reams of argument, and was paid in a small share.

BackstoryDef.title: lift engineer
BackstoryDef.description: Dwemer lifts run by water and counterweight and rarely fall. [PAWN_nameDef] was the reason for that "rarely", in the good sense of the word.

BackstoryDef.title: ore assayer
BackstoryDef.description: Every load of ore gets a number from the assayer, and the whole clan's budget follows it. [PAWN_nameDef] was offered many bribes and declined most.

BackstoryDef.title: pipe inspector
BackstoryDef.description: Miles of pipes run beneath a city, and any of them might be the one that fails. [PAWN_nameDef] walked them with a hammer, tapping and listening.

BackstoryDef.title: fungus-hall steward
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody eats a hall's accounts, but people do eat its mushrooms. [PAWN_nameDef] ran one and thought that made it the only real job in the city.

BackstoryDef.title: bronze mirror maker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] polished great mirrors to lead light down from the surface. Each one had to be set at its angle by hand and was quite beautiful, though nobody remarked on it.

BackstoryDef.title: bathhouse keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Water heated by the vents is the one luxury all Dwemer agree on. [PAWN_nameDef] ran a bathhouse where the great clans' feuds went on without any clothes.

BackstoryDef.title: cold-forge smith
BackstoryDef.description: Some alloys take the hammer only when cold, and they hate it. [PAWN_nameDef]'s right arm is noticeably larger than the left, and [PAWN_pronoun] is rather proud of it.

BackstoryDef.title: clan chronicler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wrote the histories down exactly as they happened, then got told which ones to rewrite. Both versions exist, in separate vaults.

BackstoryDef.title: ventilator keeper
BackstoryDef.description: The great fans turn day and night, and nobody thinks of them except when they stop. [PAWN_nameDef] made sure nobody had to think about them.

BackstoryDef.title: arch-mason
BackstoryDef.description: Nothing holds a mountain up but good arithmetic. [PAWN_nameDef] cut keystones for a whole district and walks under them without looking up.

BackstoryDef.title: cook for the night shift
BackstoryDef.description: Deep shifts run around the clock and a shift worker's mood depends on supper. [PAWN_nameDef] fed thousands, and was perhaps the most important person in the hold.

BackstoryDef.title: deep-lake fisher
BackstoryDef.description: Fish in the lake below Blackreach have no eyes and no fear. [PAWN_nameDef] pulled them up by the basket and came to prefer their company.

BackstoryDef.title: contract notary
BackstoryDef.description: Dwemer oaths are kept partly because of honor and partly because someone like [PAWN_nameDef] has them on file. The second reason is thought more reliable.

BackstoryDef.title: cartographer of the deep
BackstoryDef.description: Maps of a Dwemer city go down as much as across. [PAWN_nameDef] drew them on stacked sheets of thin bronze and could lose an afternoon on a single stairwell.

BackstoryDef.title: mechanical toy maker
BackstoryDef.description: Small brass spiders that walk across a table are of no practical use. [PAWN_nameDef] made them anyway, and several elders secretly kept one.

BackstoryDef.title: ore-wagon master
BackstoryDef.description: Pack beasts are rare in a mountain, but they are needed where the rails end. [PAWN_nameDef] drove the wagons down to the smelters and knew all their names.

BackstoryDef.title: trade envoy to Skyrim
BackstoryDef.description: Nords paid well for Dwemer metal, once they'd stopped trying to rob you for it. [PAWN_nameDef] sat through a great many mead halls for the sake of the clan's books.

BackstoryDef.title: dye-chemist
BackstoryDef.description: Bright colors are hard to come by underground, so a chemist has good prospects there. [PAWN_nameDef] got a very fine purple out of a very bad fungus.

BackstoryDef.title: hold magistrate
BackstoryDef.description: Justice in the hold went by written rule and without any mercy to speak of. [PAWN_nameDef] applied the rule and had lunch at the regular time.

BackstoryDef.title: ruin-born
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a corner of an old city, where the family had always lived, and no one could say how long. Rats and spheres shared the place on fair terms.

BackstoryDef.title: hidden clan elder
BackstoryDef.description: Saying that Clan Rourken survived is a very good way to attract treasure hunters. [PAWN_nameDef] held the clan together by saying nothing to anyone for many years.

BackstoryDef.title: fragment reader
BackstoryDef.description: Half the old texts rotted long ago and the other half are wrong. [PAWN_nameDef] pieced together what could be read and guessed at the rest, and told no one which was which.

BackstoryDef.title: surface passer
BackstoryDef.description: A short elf in a heavy hood can get by in a Hammerfell market. [PAWN_nameDef] brought back the clan's food for years, and has never once been asked the right question.
